text: Appendix 3 â€˜THE INTELLIGENCE CYCLE The Intelligence Cycle is the process by which information is acquired, converted into intelligence, and made available to policy makers.
text_raw:
Appendix 3 
â€˜THE INTELLIGENCE CYCLE 
The Intelligence Cycle 
is the process by which information is acquired, converted into 
intelligence, and made available to policy makers.

text: There are usually five steps that constitute The Intelligence Cycle.
text_raw:
There are 
usually five steps that constitute The Intelligence Cycle.

text: Planning and Direction This involves the management of the entire effort, from the identification of the need for data to the final delivery of an intelligence product to a customer.
text_raw:
Planning and Direction 
This involves the management of the entire effort, from the 
identification of the need for data to the final delivery of an 
intelligence product to a customer.

text: The whole process is initiated by requests or requirements for intelligence on certain subjects.
text_raw:
The whole process is initiated by requests or requirements for 
intelligence on certain subjects.

text: These are based on the ulti- mate needs of the policy makersâ€”the president, the National Security Council, and other major departments and agencies of government.
text_raw:
These are based on the ulti- 
mate needs of the policy makersâ€”the president, the National 
Security Council, and other major departments and agencies 
of government.

text: Collection This involves the gathering of the raw data from which fin- ished intelligence will be produced.
text_raw:
Collection 
This involves the gathering of the raw data from which fin- 
ished intelligence will be produced.

text: There are many sources for the collection of information, including foreign radio- broadcasts, newspapers, periodicals and official government personnel stationed in American embassies abroad.
text_raw:
There are many sources 
for the collection of information, including foreign radio- 
broadcasts, newspapers, periodicals and official government 
personnel stationed in American embassies abroad.

text: Finally, technical collectionâ€”photography and electronicsâ€”has come to play an indispensable part in modern intelligence by extending the United Statesâ€™ sensory systemâ€”its eyes and ears.

come to play an indispensable part in modern intelligence by 
extending the United Statesâ€™ sensory systemâ€”its eyes and ears.

text: Processing This step is concerned with the conversion of the vast amount of information coming into the system to a form more suitable for the production of finished intelligence, such as language translations, decryption and sorting by subject matter.
text_raw:
Processing 
This step is concerned with the conversion of the vast amount 
of information coming into the system to a form more suitable 
for the production of finished intelligence, such as language 
translations, decryption and sorting by subject matter.

text: The information that does not go directly to analysts is sorted and made available for rapid computer retrieval.
text_raw:

information that does not go directly to analysts is sorted and 
made available for rapid computer retrieval.

text: Processing also refers to data reductionâ€”interpretation of the information stored on film and tape through the use of highly refined photographic and electronic processes.

text: Production and Analysis This refers to the conversion of basic information into fin- ished intelligence.

Production and Analysis 
This refers to the conversion of basic information into fin- 
ished intelligence.

text: It includes the integration, evaluation and analysis of all available data and the preparation of a variety of intelligence products.
text_raw:

analysis of all available data and the preparation of a variety of 
intelligence products.

text: Such products or estimates may be pre- sented as briefings, brief reports or lengthy studies.

at times contradictory.

text: Analysts, who are subject-matter spe- cialists for a particular country, produce finished intelligence by evaluating and integrating the various pieces of data and interpreting their meaning and significance.
